text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how hard Narita Brian tries, she can't envision winning against Symboli Rudolf. She continues to struggle through this darkness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She reveals everything on her mind, and I answer her with an unwavering faith that she can win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing that, Narita Brian regains composure. She seems to remember that I've always believed in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, at a press conference before the Japan Cup, Narita Brian announces her intention to defeat the Emperor, and gives Symboli Rudolf a firm handshake.
